title: Get a permit to trade or run a stall in a public place
what: Get the council's permit before selling goods or services from a stall, or otherwise trading, in a street, on council property or in another public place.

confidence_note: Quotes the local law as made, from the WA Government Gazette; WA publishes no consolidated local laws. The clause was found by a pattern search of every Gazette from 1996 to 2026 (E-8), and the law was taken as in force because no later repeal naming it was found. The council adopted the Kojonup local law with modifications (Gazette No. 130, 29 Jul 2008); the clause is quoted from that law as made.
